mapper.sql: id, shop_id, poi_id, max_bid_amount, source, raw_message, observed_at, expire_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mt_promotion_bid_constraint ( shop_id, poi_id, max_bid_amount, source, raw_message, observed_at, expire_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{shopId}, #{poiId}, #{maxBidAmount}, #{source}, #{rawMessage}, #{observedAt}, #{expireAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE poi_id = VALUES(poi_id), max_bid_amount = VALUES(max_bid_amount), source = VALUES(source), raw_message = VALUES(raw_message), observed_at = VALUES(observed_at), expire_at = VALUES(expire_at), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
